_purpose: evolve_runner.py usage notes for tau3-bench ARM-B benchmark

calibration_check.description: Before running benchmark items, verify runner faithfulness using Pilot 1 source
calibration_check.instruction: If calibration output does not match expected values, do not proceed with benchmark items. Contact Evolve Edge.

frozen_baseline.note: The runner and all atom files must remain frozen from the point of benchmark package delivery until all four conditions (Baseline, ARM-A, ARM-B, ARM-C) have been run and results recorded. No updates during the benchmark run.

gold_blind_rule: Do not evaluate any condition's output against the external gold until all four conditions have completed their runs on all items.
